title.zh: 将达沃省Tagum市镇达沃区域医院床位由150张增至200张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Davao Regional Hospital in the Municipality of Tagum, Province of Davao, From One Hundred Fifty (150) to Two Hundred (200) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Davao Regional Hospital in the Municipality of Tagum, Province of Davao, From One Hundred Fifty (150) to Two Hundred (200) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Vùng Davao tại Đô thị Tagum, Tỉnh Davao từ 150 lên 200 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลภูมิภาค Davao ในเทศบาล Tagum จังหวัด Davao จาก 150 เป็น 200 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Regional Davao di Kotamadya Tagum, Provinsi Davao dari 150 menjadi 200 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Wilayah Davao di Perbandaran Tagum, Wilayah Davao daripada 150 kepada 200 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7179_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Davao Regional Hospital in the Municipality of Tagum, Province of Davao, is hereby increased from one hundred fifty (150) to two hundred (200) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
